settings.title: Academy
settings.body: Your academy's name and contact details, as staff and parents see them.
settings.readOnly: You can see these settings. Only the owner can change them.

fields.name: Academy name
fields.phoneHint: A 10-digit Indian mobile number, or a number with its country code.
fields.timezoneHint: Class times and “today” follow this timezone.

permission.title: Academy settings aren't available
permission.body: Ask the owner of {academy} if you need to see them.

branding.title: Branding & address
branding.body: Your logo, colour and AcademyBee address.
branding.readOnly: You can see your academy's branding. Only the owner can change it.
branding.unavailable: Uploads aren't available right now. Your academy's initials are shown until they are.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. A square or wide logo on a plain background works best.
logo.none: No logo yet: your academy's initials are shown instead.

favicon.title: Browser icon
favicon.hint: A small square image shown in browser tabs. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB.
favicon.none: No browser icon yet: your academy's initials are used.

colour.title: Brand colour
colour.hint: Used behind your academy's initials and on its app icon. Text on it must stay readable.
colour.readable: Readable: text on this colour meets the contrast standard.
colour.unreadable: Text isn't readable on this colour. Choose a darker or lighter shade.

preview.title: Preview
preview.note: Status colours and buttons keep AcademyBee's colours, so they stay clear in both themes.

address.title: AcademyBee address
address.hint: Staff and parents sign in here. To change it, contact AcademyBee support.

permission.title: Branding isn't available
permission.body: Ask the owner of {academy} if you need to see it.

errors.unsupported_type: That isn't a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.too_large_dimensions: That image is too big. Use one at most 4096 pixels wide or tall.
errors.uploads_unavailable: Uploads aren't available right now. Try again later.
errors.low_contrast: Text isn't readable on this colour. Choose a darker or lighter shade.
errors.versionConflict: Someone else changed these settings just now. Reload the page to see their changes.
errors.invalidPhone: Enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number, or a number with its country code.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
errors.offline: You're offline. Changes need a connection.
errors.generic: That didn't save. Try again; if it keeps failing, reload the page.
